'''Zisia''' was a rich [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Zisia system/Legends|Zisia system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] controlled by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The planet lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called [[the Dead Road]], which connected it to the worlds of [[Elgit]] and [[Ulmatra/Legends|Ulmatra]]. Zisia was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Zisian]] species, members of which served as pliant [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] for [[Time/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zisia was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square S-10.<ref name="TEA" />
